chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his uncle Yaʿqūb al-Aḥmar, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

And any woman who was in iʿtikāf, then salat (prayer) became forbidden to her, so she left the masjid, then she became pure, it is not proper for her husband to have intercourse with her until she returns to the masjid and completes her iʿtikāf.

key_terms.اعْتِكَافَهَا: her iʿtikāf that must be completed
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the masjid from which she exited and to which she must return
key_terms.حَرُمَتْ عَلَيْهَا الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer) became prohibited for her due to menstruation
key_terms.فَطَهُرَتْ: she became ritually pure after the state preventing salat ended
key_terms.مُعْتَكِفَةً: a woman observing iʿtikāf in the masjid
key_terms.يُجَامِعَهَا: to have sexual intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: Can a husband have intercourse with his wife after she becomes pure if her iʿtikāf was interrupted by menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman performing iʿtikāf who leaves the masjid when menstruation begins. After she becomes pure, her husband should not have intercourse with her until she returns to the masjid and completes her iʿtikāf.
